description: Values that look like markdown or HTML (`**x**`, `[a](javascript:…)`, a newline plus `## heading` / `- item`, ``) inserted through `${…}` render as text inside the node where the atom sits: no heading, list, link, image or handler is built.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 `<md>` F1 "a" (`${…}` inside `<md>` is TEXT-ONLY)
rationale: §67.4 (F1): an atom's value is inserted as text and SHALL NEVER create markdown structure; structure is read from the literal text only. §67.6: content reaches the DOM only as text nodes or listed attribute values.

domAnchored.selector: #w img, #w h1, #w h2, #w ul, #w li, #w script
